Functional principal components of phenotype trajectories

Source: R/functional_environment.R
pheno_fpca.Rd

Functional principal components of phenotype trajectories

Usage

pheno_fpca(x, ncomp = 3L, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A pheno_functional object.

ncomp

Number of components to retain.

center

Center trajectories.

scale.

Scale grid columns before PCA.

Value

A pheno_fpca object containing scores, loadings and explained variance.

References

Yao F, Mueller HG, Wang JL (2005). JASA 100:577-590. doi:10.1198/016214504000001745 .

Examples

d <- subset(pheno_data("growth_series"), trait == "leaf_area")
f <- pheno_functional(d,"plant_id","day","value")
pheno_fpca(f,ncomp=2)
